title: Horizontal wind force
description: Essential: The final answer for the horizontal wind force must be 20 N.

title: Rope tension force
description: Essential: The final answer for the rope tension must be 40 N.

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply equilibrium conditions (sum of forces = 0) in both horizontal and vertical directions.

title: Correct force decomposition
description: Important: The tension force must be decomposed into horizontal (T cos 60°) and vertical (T sin 60°) components using the given angle.

title: Buoyancy relation
description: Important: The vertical equilibrium must correctly relate the vertical tension component (T sin 60°) to the given buoyant force of 20√3 N.

title: Trigonometric evaluation
description: Optional: Correct evaluation of cos 60° = 1/2 and sin 60° = √3/2 should be shown or used accurately.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Final answers should be presented with the correct unit (N) and without extraneous units or symbols.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if force components are assigned incorrect signs or directions, violating equilibrium.

title: Angle misuse
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the trigonometric functions are swapped (e.g., using sin for horizontal component) or if the wrong angle (30° instead of 60°) is used.
